name: EKODI User UI Shell
purpose: Keep one EKODI user experience while allowing each service to preserve its own visual family.

forbidden: service-specific copy of shared header runtime
admin navigation mixed into user header

footer.layout: operator-copy-left / legal-links-right; stack on narrow screens
footer.themePolicy: inherit each service typography and color mood; optional --ekodi-user-footer-* tokens may refine it

inheritance.hostRule: all public/workspace service hosts inherit the manifest service shell
inheritance.pathRule: all subordinate paths inherit their parent service shell
inheritance.rootServiceRule: ekodi.kr/<service>/... inherits that service when the route is a user surface
